reviewWorkflowSettingsPanel.controleOQueA: Control what the AI is allowed to suggest on its own.

reviewWorkflowSettingsPanel.exigirRevisaoManualCom: Require manual review when fields are missing
reviewWorkflowSettingsPanel.exigirRevisaoManualCom2: Require manual review when fields are missing

reviewWorkflowSettingsPanel.nomesSaoSanitizadosSem: Names are sanitized (no slashes or path traversal), capped at about 180 characters and forced to the .pdf extension. Tax IDs do not go into the suggested name automatically while the protection is on.
